answer.prompt: Edit image 1, the room. Images 2–5 are products to add, one per image; keep everything else unchanged. Image 2: the light wood dining table, in the free floor in the middle of the room, about 1.5 m in front of the kitchenette counter and oven, centered between the left white column and the right wall. Its long side runs parallel to the kitchen front. It spans about a quarter of the image width. Image 3: four of these black chairs around that table, two on each long side, tucked in and facing the table. Image 4: the white bell pendant, hung from the ceiling directly above the table's center, its bottom about 75 cm above the tabletop. Image 5: the sideboard, back flat against the long white right wall, level with the first wall outlet (between the light switch and the second outlet). It faces left into the room, foreshortened along the wall, about a fifth of the image width. The floor in the front half of the image, near the camera, stays empty. Copy each product's design exactly: shape, proportions, colors, materials, herringbone fronts, brass legs and handles. Do not substitute similar pieces. Product photos are studio catalog shots, often renders, and give the design only. Make each piece look photographed in this room by this camera. Use the soft, even daylight from the camera side, with gentle shading on surfaces facing away. Match the white balance, contrast, grain and sharpness. Add soft contact shadows on the floor and subtle real wood grain and wear. Keep the same framing, camera, walls, floor, kitchen and light, and add nothing else. Output a realistic photograph, not a render.

placements.where: mid-room, ~1.5 m in front of kitchenette
around the table, two per long side
against right wall, level with first outlet
